description: Agent control: agent.report keeps draft and pid in props.agent (a report without them forgets them), agent.report_session keeps model and thinking (a report without them keeps the last), agent.list says open, focused, draft, model and thinking, and agent.restart's checks: target, mode, args, then its refusals in order (blocked, working, a draft, a draft nothing reports), and resume without a recorded session. Never a restart that goes through: the app really relaunches the session.

ignore.response.result.agents.*.pid: the agent's process: a reported pid only while that process lives, else the zmx session's foreground process (client)
ignore.response.result.agents.*.live: whether the tile's zmx session runs (client)
ignore.response.result.agents.*.program: the terminal's foreground program comes from its live surface (client)
ignore.response.result.agents.*.title: the terminal's OSC title comes from its live surface (client)

steps.note: no such process (macOS pids stay below 100000): props.agent keeps it, agent.list leaves it out
a model and thinking level, but no session to resume
without model and thinking: both kept
blocked, with a draft too: the dialog is named first
working, with a draft too: the turn is named first
forced past the draft: no session was ever recorded to resume
idle, and nothing says whether its editor holds a draft: one the user may have
